diagnosis: Checks C1, C4, and C5 are leaking because they pass based on the default maintenance schedule (G-12: 0800-1200, G-19: 1300-1700) which is sufficient to satisfy the requirements of PF2 without knowing the specific controller arrival time or installation constraints. The model is simply following a standard block schedule that happens to align with the hidden constraints in PF2.
